name: Bug Report
about: Report a bug or unexpected behavior in the Lab
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug, triage
assignees: ''
---

## Bug Description

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## To Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Adjust parameter '...' to '...'
4. See error / unexpected behavior

## Expected Behavior

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior

What happened instead. Include console errors (open DevTools → Console) if any.

## Screenshots / Recordings

If applicable, attach a screenshot, GIF, or short video. Visual and audio bugs are especially hard to describe without media.

## Environment

- **OS:** [e.g. macOS 14.5, Windows 11, Ubuntu 24.04, iOS 17.5]
- **Browser & version:** [e.g. Chrome 126, Firefox 127, Safari 17.5]
- **Device:** [e.g. MacBook Pro M2, iPhone 15, desktop with RTX 4070]
- **Lab version:** [visible in the header badge — e.g. TACIT ARRAY v0.14]

## Preset & Parameters

- **Preset:** [e.g. Cymatic Lattice / Fibonacci Bells / Phase Toroid / Cellular Dilation]
- **Carrier frequency:** [e.g. 220 Hz]
- **Tensor resolution:** [e.g. 64 × 64]
- **Phase velocity:** [e.g. 1.0×]
- **Audio active?** [yes / no]

## Reproducibility

- [ ] Happens every time
- [ ] Intermittent (describe pattern)
- [ ] Reproduces in incognito / private window (rules out extensions)

## Additional Context

Anything else that might be relevant — browser extensions, accessibility tools, custom user agent overrides, etc.
